answer_1.quote: Given a query q and a large corpus of text C (e.g. Wikipedia), AQA consists of predicting an answer a and a passage p ∈ C to attribute the predicted answer... The generator (MGEN) generates a short answer based on the top‑ranked documents.

answer_2.quote: we measure the accuracy of a system by counting the proportion of answers with an attributed passage. We refer to this score as AIS.

answer_3.quote: We frame attribution detection as a binary classification task... We use PaLM 2 ... fine‑tuned on a very small sample of our collected data.

answer_4.quote: For each (query, answer, passage) triplet, we ask three raters to answer "Is the answer attributed to the passage?"
answer_4.guideline: Raters are asked to judge whether the generated answer can be attributed to the retrieved passage.
